notes.title: The Release
notes.notes:
Only Cards is releasing right now!



This is kind of a new experience for me, since I almost always did action/arcade games before. But now, I love tabletop games too. Someone may say that the game is too small and simple, but I enjoyed core mechanics of Only Cards very much. This is probably the most original game I ever made. And I hope you play and see this beauty in card mechanics, too.



This was a harsh year for adult games on Steam. But I'll continue to make games as long as I can. To everyone who participated in this project, or just played the demo, thank you!

notes.title: The release date will be announced soon
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! The game is almost ready, but the moderation process is unfortunately taking much longer than expected. This is not surprising, considering the recent situation with adult games on Steam.

I hope to release the game at the beginning of September.





Thank you for following the game!
